verses.1: And remember your creations in those days of your greatness, when the days of evil would not come. But then came those years when it was said, “I have no hope for them.”
verses.2: Until the sun, light, wind, and stars no longer shine. Then the clouds will return after their journey.
verses.3: On the day when the doors of the house were opened, and the people of the tribe stood up in fear. They removed their shields, for the darkness covered the streets.
verses.4: And their doors were closed in the marketplace, amidst the sound of the hammering. Then, the sound of the trumpets would rise, and all the branches of the tree would be destroyed.
verses.5: Also, from above, they will be seen and heard along the way. The seeds will be scattered, and the fruits will fall like ripe fruits. As people go back home, they will be surrounded by the fields of thorns.
verses.6: Until the chain of gold is not tightened, and the gold floor remains loose. Then it will be fixed on its place, and the ring will be broken into pieces.
verses.7: And the sun will stand on the earth, just as it was before. And the wind will return to God who has given it to us.
verses.8: “Wastefulness and foolishness,” said the prophet. “All is wastefulness.”
verses.9: And those who remained wise would still strive to understand the teachings of God. They would also observe and study the laws and regulations that govern human behavior.
verses.10: I seek a congregation that can find words of truth, and let those who write down such words be recognized as true believers.
verses.11: The words of the wise men, as they were taught and preserved, were given to us by one who was wise.
verses.12: And from those who are like them, my children, beware! They make many records. There’s no end to them. And their efforts will surely lead to failure.
verses.13: At last, all these words were heard. Man feared God and obeyed His commands, for that is what every human being should do.
verses.14: For all that God does, He does it in accordance with justice, whether it is good or bad.
